annotations.title: Link a product feed to a Reddit catalog

description: Have Reddit FETCH your product file (CSV/TSV/XML at a public https:// or FTP/SFTP address — a Shopify, Google Merchant or WooCommerce product feed works) into a catalog, once or on a schedule. mode REPLACE (default) treats the file as the whole catalog, so products missing from it are removed; UPDATE only adds and changes. A catalog takes at most TWO feeds and they must be of different types. Feed credentials (username/password) go to Reddit and are never echoed back. Spends nothing. Check how the import went with list_reddit_ads_catalogs(catalogId) then get_reddit_ads_catalog_import. Read back from Reddit.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

catalogId.description: catalog to import the feed into

mode.description: default REPLACE — the file is the whole catalog

password.description: password for the feed URL; sent to Reddit and never echoed back

schedule.description: how often Reddit re-fetches the file; omit for a one-off

interval.description: HOURLY, DAILY, WEEKLY or MONTHLY re-fetch cadence

username.description: only if the url needs a login

name: create_reddit_ads_product_feed
title: Link a product feed to a Reddit catalog
